case_title: State of Gujarat v. Jayrajbhai Punjabhai Varu
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 302 and sentenced to rigorous life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused, who was the husband of the deceased, was residing in his matrimonial home with his in-laws. The deceased sustained severe burn injuries and was admitted to a hospital. She provided a statement to a police officer and an Executive Magistrate, both of which described an unknown person who poured kerosene on her and set her on fire. The deceased did not name her husband or his family members in these statements. The deceased later died in the hospital. The father of the deceased provided an oral dying declaration, which was used by the trial court to convict the accused. The High Court, however, acquitted the accused, citing inconsistencies in the evidence and the need for careful scrutiny of the dying declaration.
